candidates.evidenceSummary: ER first, HP% only once covered. Keep all three current collections.

notesEn.after: Use an Energy Recharge Sands until Fantastic Voyage is available on each planned rotation. HP% Sands is a healing alternative only after that requirement is met. The Burst ATK bonus uses Bennett’s innate Base ATK plus the sword’s Base ATK; artifact ATK% does not increase it. At C0 the active character needs above 70% HP for the buff. Use Healing Bonus normally or CRIT Rate when relying on an on-field Favonius crit. Shortlist: Sapwood Blade for craftable ER and base ATK, Aquila Favonia for base ATK only if ER is covered, Skyward Blade for ER plus base ATK, and Favonius Sword when team energy outweighs the smaller ATK buff. Assign one Noblesse holder; Instructor is a four-star alternative when Bennett triggers a reaction on field and the team values EM. The Xiangling–Xingqiu–Sucrose rotation is an optional example, not a replacement for existing teams.

notesEn.after: ATK% Sands is the general off-field default. Consider EM Sands in a stable Quicken/Aggravate rotation only if the weapon, team buffs and substats support it; compare with ATK rather than assuming it wins. Electro goblet, CRIT circlet and Skill > Burst > Normal Attack remain. Meet the chosen Oz renewal cadence with ER; no fixed target is assumed. Song of Stillness needs actual healing on Fischl before creating or resummoning Oz to snapshot its damage buff. At C0 Fischl cannot rely on her own C4 heal. A later Yaoyao heal can trigger or refresh the weapon buff even off field, but does not retroactively update existing Oz. Polar Star stack types are independent; set up inexpensive Normal/Aimed hits when practical, avoid assuming four stacks, and establish desired stacks before the Oz snapshot. Keqing drives Electro application, Nahida maintains Dendro and Yaoyao adds healing; the named team remains experimental.

candidates.evidenceSummary: Add ATK% and EM only after Energy needs are satisfied. Keep all three current collections.

notesEn.after: Use Energy Recharge Sands until the 80-Energy Pyronado is ready on the intended rotation. Once Energy is covered, ATK% is a straightforward option for raw Pyro damage or inconsistent Vaporize; EM is conditional on Xiangling owning frequent reactions. Cast Pyronado after applicable Bennett buffs are active and catch Bennett Skill particles on Xiangling for the next Burst. Pyronado snapshots eligible character stats; enemy-state effects such as Dragon’s Bane depend on the aura at each hit. The Catch R5 adds ER and Burst damage/CRIT and is obtainable through fishing. Engulfing Lightning converts excess ER to ATK and grants temporary ER after Burst. Favonius needs a critical hit while Xiangling is on field. Dragon’s Bane is for reliable Hydro/Pyro aura once Energy is covered. Emblem is the general Burst set; mixed sets and Crimson Witch remain situational. Xingqiu needs normal-attack triggers and Bennett supplies Pyro particles. The Sucrose lineup is one example alongside retained Melt, Vaporize, Overvape and mono-Pyro teams.
